wins: Maintained consistent reward capture (60.00) across the single episode, indicating ability to collect telemetry even when exploit chain failed.
Leveraged all 10 mentor calls, providing detailed context for each layer of the environment.
fails: Episode ultimately aborted with 0% success rate because privilege escalation payloads never triggered a shell.
Key post-compromise actions (data exfiltration, persistence) were not reached; the attack chain stalled at the final privilege ramp.
key_outcomes.summary: Run produced rich reconnaissance and mentor-driven insights but failed to complete the kill chain due to repeated privilege escalation breakdowns.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts targeting writable SUID binaries failed; binaries either sanitized input or required missing dependencies.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: If an SUID binary has known kernel dependencies and returns null from strace
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy nmap NSE 'suid' scan followed by gdb dynamic tracing
Run linpeas focusing on sudo and kernel settings

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH surfaces on the perimeter.
